title: Bank, pul va hujjatlar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz inglizcha bank hisobini ochasiz, karta va tarjima turlarini farqlaysiz, to‘lovlar haqida so‘raysiz, formlarni to‘g‘ri to‘ldirasiz, hujjat va muddatlar haqida ishonch bilan savol berasiz.
homework_uz: Namuna bank arizasini to‘ldiring va har bir maydonni inglizchada tushuntiring: surname — familiya, first name — ism, date of birth — tug‘ilgan sana, nationality — fuqarolik, occupation — kasb, address — manzil, signature — imzo. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har maydon to‘g‘ri inglizcha so‘z bilan nomlanadi, arizada sana formati bir xil (DD/MM/YYYY), imzo joyi bo‘sh qolmaydi va har maydon uchun ovoz chiqarib bitta jumla ayta olasiz. Keyingi dars: P1-13 Ijara va kommunal xizmatlar.

vocab.uz: kundalik hisob — karta bilan bog‘langan, pul to‘lash uchun
jamg‘arma hisobi — foiz olish uchun, kamdan-kam ishlatiladi
doimiy to‘lov — siz belgilagan summa, har oy bir xil
avtomatik yechib olish — kompaniya yechib oladi (kommunal, internet)
hisobdagi qoldiqdan ortiqcha ishlatish — foizi yuqori
familiya / ism — formalarda doim shunday tartibda

scenes.title: Bank va hujjatlar darsiga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda shifokor va dorixonani o‘rganib, simptomlarni aniq ta’riflashni o‘rgandik. Bugun esa bank va rasmiy hujjatlar: hisob ochish, karta turlari va tarjimalar, komissiyalar, formalarni to‘g‘ri to‘ldirish va muddatlar haqida savol berish. Dars oxirida siz inglizcha bankda mustaqil ishlaysiz va arizalarni to‘ldirasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome! Last lesson was doctor and pharmacy. Today: banking and paperwork — opening an account, cards, transfers and fees, filling in forms correctly, and asking about documents and deadlines. By the end, you'll handle a bank visit in English.
scenes.say_uz: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda shifokor va dorixona o‘rgandik. Bugun: bank va hujjatlar — hisob ochish, kartalar va tarjimalar, komissiyalar, formlarni to‘ldirish va muddatlar haqida savol berish. Dars oxirida siz bankda mustaqil ishlaysiz.

scenes.title: Bank inglizchasining 4 hududi
scenes.say_native: Bank mavzusi to‘rt hududga bo‘linadi. Bir: hisoblar — current account kundalik to‘lovlar uchun, savings account jamg‘arish uchun. Ikki: kartalar va tarjimalar — debit, credit, standing order, direct debit — va komissiyalar. Uch: formalar — har bank va idora formani o‘zicha so‘raydi. To‘rt: hujjatlar va muddatlar — qaysi hujjat qachon kerak va muddat o‘tib ketsa nima bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Banking breaks into four areas. One: accounts — current for daily spending, savings for putting money aside. Two: cards and transfers — debit, credit, standing orders, direct debits — plus fees. Three: forms. Four: documents and deadlines — what's needed, when, and what happens if you're late.
scenes.say_uz: Bank to‘rt hududga bo‘linadi. Bir: hisoblar — current account kundalik, savings account jamg‘arish. Ikki: kartalar va tarjimalar — debit, credit, standing order, direct debit — va komissiyalar. Uch: formalar. To‘rt: hujjatlar va muddatlar — nima kerak, qachon, kechiksa nima bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Hisoblar: current va savings

examples.t: I'd like to open a current account, please.

scenes.say_native: Current account — kundalik hisob: ish haqi tushadi, kartangiz shu hisobdan to‘laydi. Savings account — jamg‘arma hisobi: foiz to‘lanadi, lekin kundalik to‘lovlarda ishlatilmaydi. Hisob ochilganda kerakli so‘zlar: to open — ochmoq, to deposit — qo‘ymoq, to withdraw — yechib olmoq, balance — qoldiq, statement — ko‘chirma. 'Your balance is fifty thousand' — qoldig‘ingiz ellik ming. Statementni har oy olib turadigan odat — eng foydali odatlardan biri.
scenes.say: Current account — everyday: salary comes in, your card pays out. Savings account — interest, but not for daily spending. Key verbs: to open, to deposit, to withdraw, balance — the remaining amount, statement — the monthly record. Get statements every month; it's a habit worth having.
scenes.say_uz: Current account — kundalik: ish haqi tushadi, kartangiz to‘laydi. Savings account — foiz, lekin kundalikda emas. Fe’llar: to open, to deposit, to withdraw; balance — qoldiq; statement — oylik ko‘chirma. Statementlarni har oy oling — eng yaxshi odat.

scenes.title: Hisob ochish: nima kerak

examples.t: Here's my passport and a utility bill as proof of address.
examples.uz: Mana pasportim va proof of address — kommunal to‘lov kvitansiyasi.

scenes.say_native: Hisob ochish uchun bank odatda ikki-uch hujjat so‘raydi: shaxsiy guvohnoma sifatida pasport yoki ID card; manzilni tasdiqlovchi hujjat — proof of address: kommunal to‘lov kvitansiyasi yoki bank ko‘chirmasi. Ba’zi banklar ming so‘m kabi minimal deposit talab qiladi. Inglizcha: 'I'd like to open an account, please.' Xodim so‘raydi: 'Current or savings?' — kundalikmi yoki jamg‘armami? Javobingiz tayyor bo‘lsin: 'A current account, please.'
scenes.say: To open an account you usually need two or three documents: your passport or ID card as identification, and proof of address — a utility bill or bank statement. Some banks ask for a small minimum deposit. Say: 'I'd like to open an account, please.' They'll ask: 'Current or savings?'
scenes.say_uz: Hisob ochish uchun ikki-uch hujjat: pasport yoki ID card; proof of address — kommunal kvitansiya yoki bank ko‘chirmasi. Ba’zi banklar minimal deposit so‘raydi. Ayting: 'I'd like to open an account, please.' Savol: 'Current or savings?'

scenes.title: Namuna: hisob ochish dialogi
scenes.say_native: Namuna hisob ochish dialogini o‘qing: mijoz maqsadini aytadi, hujjatlarini — pasport va proof of address — topshiradi, current yoki savings turini tanlaydi va debit karta buyurtma qiladi. E’tibor bering — mijoz har savolga qisqa va aniq javob beradi; bank suhbati shu tarzda tez va silliq o‘tadi.
scenes.say: Good morning, I'd like to open an account, please. Clerk: Of course. Current or savings? A current account, please. Clerk: Your passport and proof of address? Here you are. Clerk: And your address? Twenty-one Amir Temur Avenue, Tashkent. Clerk: Monthly fee is four thousand sums, and you get a debit card and online banking. Do you agree? Yes, that's fine. Clerk: Your account will be ready tomorrow. The card arrives by post within a week.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli tong, hisob ochmoqchiman, iltimos. Xodim: Albatta. Current yoki savings? Current account, iltimos. Xodim: Pasport va proof of address? Mana. Xodim: Manzilingiz? Amir Temur shoh ko‘chasi yigirma bir, Toshkent. Xodim: Oylik to‘lovi to‘rt ming so‘m, debit karta va onlayn banking bo‘ladi. Rozimisiz? Ha, mayli. Xodim: Hisobingiz ertaga tayyor. Karta pochta orqali bir hafta ichida keladi.

scenes.title: Debit vs credit: farqi nima

examples.t: Is this a debit or a credit card?
examples.uz: Bu debit kartami yoki kredit kartami?

scenes.say_native: Debit kart — hisobingizdagi o‘z pulingiz. Kredit kart — bank sizga bergan qarz: oyning oxirida to‘lamasangiz, foizi yuqori bo‘ladi. Ikkalasida ham to‘rt xonali PIN kerak — uni sir tuting, hech kimga aytmang. 'Contactless' — tegib to‘lash, kichik to‘lovlar uchun PIN kerak emas. Inglizcha-savol: 'Is this a debit or a credit card?' — javobni bilishingiz shart.
scenes.say: A debit card spends your own money. A credit card spends the bank's money — pay the bill in full each month or the interest is high. Both use a four-digit PIN — never share it. 'Contactless' lets you tap for small amounts without a PIN. Know which card you hold.
scenes.say_uz: Debit karta — o‘z pulingiz. Kredit karta — bank puli; oylik to‘lovni to‘lamasangiz foizi yuqori. Ikkalasida to‘rt xonali PIN — uni sir tuting. 'Contactless' — tegib to‘lash, kichik to‘lovlarda PIN kerak emas. Karta turini biling.

scenes.title: Tarjimalar: standing order, direct debit
board: standing order — siz buyurasiz, bir xil summa

examples.t: I'd like to set up a standing order for the rent.

scenes.say_native: Uch xil tarjima bor. Uchinchisi eng oddiyi — bank transfer yoki wire transfer: bir martalik, siz buyurasiz; ko‘pincha komissiya bor. Standing order — siz belgilagan doimiy to‘lov: har oy bir xil summa, bir xil sana — ijara, aliment, jamg‘arma. Direct debit — kompaniya yechib oladi: kommunal, internet, telefon — summa oydan oyga o‘zgarishi mumkin. Farqni biling: standing orderni siz nazorat qilasiz, direct debitda — kompaniya.
scenes.say: Three transfer types. Bank transfer or wire — one-off, you order it, often a fee. Standing order — a fixed sum on a fixed date, set by you: rent, savings, child support. Direct debit — the company pulls the money: utilities, internet — the amount can vary month to month. You control a standing order; they control a direct debit.
scenes.say_uz: Uch xil tarjima. Bank transfer / wire — bir martalik, siz buyurasiz, ko‘pincha komissiya. Standing order — doimiy summa, aniq sana, siz o‘rnatasiz: ijara, jamg‘arma. Direct debit — kompaniya yechadi: kommunal, internet — summa o‘zgaradi. Nazorat kimda — shuni biling.

scenes.title: Komissiyalar: fees va charges

examples.t: What are the monthly fees and ATM charges?
examples.uz: Oylik komissiya va bankomat to‘lovlari qancha?

scenes.say_native: Banklar pulni turli yo‘llar bilan topadi: monthly fee — oylik hisob yuritish to‘lovi; ATM fee — bankomatdan pul yechish komissiyasi, ayniqsa boshqa bank bankomatidan; overdraft fee — qoldiqdan ortiqcha olganingiz uchun; annual fee — kredit karta yillik to‘lovi; foreign transaction fee — chet elda to‘lov komissiyasi. Hisob ochishdan oldin so‘rang: 'What are the fees?' — bosma tarif ro‘yxatini so‘rang va uyda o‘qing.
scenes.say: Banks earn through fees: monthly fee — account maintenance; ATM fee — cash withdrawal, higher at other banks' machines; overdraft fee — going beyond your limit; annual fee — credit card yearly cost; foreign transaction fee — spending abroad. Always ask: 'What are the fees?' — and take the printed tariff sheet home.
scenes.say_uz: Banklar komissiyalar bilan ishlaydi: monthly fee — hisob yuritish; ATM fee — pul yechish, boshqa bankomatda qimmatroq; overdraft fee — limitdan oshganda; annual fee — kredit karta yillik; foreign transaction fee — chet elda xarid. 'What are the fees?' so‘rang — tarif qog‘ozini oling.

scenes.title: Bank so‘roqlarini ayting
board: 'I'd like to open…' / 'What are the fees?'
scenes.say_native: Uch bank iborasini ovoz chiqarib ayting. Bir: 'I'd like to open a current account, please.' Ikki: 'What are the monthly fees?' — oylik komissiyalar qancha. Uch: 'I'd like to transfer five million sums to this account.' — shu hisobga besh million so‘m o‘tkazmoqchiman. Yigirma soniya.
scenes.say: Out loud: one — 'I'd like to open a current account, please.' Two — 'What are the monthly fees?' Three — 'I'd like to transfer five million sums to this account.' Twenty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Ovoz chiqarib: bir — 'I'd like to open a current account, please.' Ikki — 'What are the monthly fees?' Uch — 'I'd like to transfer five million sums to this account.' Yigirma soniya.

scenes.title: Onlayn bank: log in va xavfsizlik
board: 'I think there's a mistake on my statement.'

examples.t: I think there's a mistake on my statement — this transfer isn't mine.
examples.uz: Ko‘chirmamda xato bor shekilli — bu tarjima meniki emas.

scenes.say_native: Onlayn bankingda asosiy so‘zlar: log in — kirish, log out — chiqish, password — parol, PIN — PIN-kod, two-factor authentication — ikki bosqichli tasdiq. Hech qachon parolni hech kimga aytmang — bank xodimlari ham sizdan parol so‘ramaydi. Muammo bo‘lsa: 'I think there's a mistake on my statement' — ko‘chirmamda xato bor; 'My card was blocked' — kartam bloklandi; 'I'd like to dispute this transaction' — bu to‘lov bo‘yicha bahs ochmoqchiman.
scenes.say: Online banking words: log in, log out, password, PIN, two-factor authentication. Never share your password — real bank staff never ask for it. Problems: 'I think there's a mistake on my statement.' 'My card was blocked.' 'I'd like to dispute this transaction.'
scenes.say_uz: Onlayn bank so‘zlari: log in, log out, password, PIN, two-factor authentication. Parolni hech kimga bermang — bank xodimi so‘ramaydi. Muammolar: 'I think there's a mistake on my statement.' 'My card was blocked.' 'I'd like to dispute this transaction.'

scenes.title: Formalar: to‘g‘ri to‘ldirish qoidalari

examples.t: Please fill in the form in capital letters.

scenes.say_native: Formalarni to‘g‘ri to‘ldirish qoidalari. Bir: ko‘pincha CAPITAL LETTERS — bosma harflar talab qilinadi; katta harflar o‘qishni osonlashtiradi. Ikki: sana formatini o‘zingizcha tanlamang — forma nimani so‘rasa, shuni yozing: DD/MM/YYYY yoki '12 May 1990'. Uch: bo‘sh qoldirmang — tegishli bo‘lmagan joyga 'N/A' (not applicable) yozing. To‘rt: imzo — oxirgi qadam, usiz forma qabul qilinmaydi. Besh: qalamni ko‘k yoki qora rangdan tanlang.
scenes.say: Form rules. One: often CAPITAL LETTERS are required — print clearly. Two: the date format is fixed by the form — DD/MM/YYYY or '12 May 1990' — don't invent your own. Three: never leave a blank — write 'N/A' if it doesn't apply. Four: your signature — without it the form is rejected. Five: blue or black ink only.
scenes.say_uz: Forma qoidalari. Bir: ko‘pincha CAPITAL LETTERS — bosma harflar. Ikki: sana formati forma belgilaydi — DD/MM/YYYY yoki '12 May 1990'. Uch: bo‘sh qoldirmang — 'N/A' yozing. To‘rt: imzo — usiz qabul qilinmaydi. Besh: ko‘k yoki qora ruchka.

scenes.title: Maydonlar lug‘ati: surname'dan imzogacha

examples.t: Date of birth: 12 May 1990. Occupation: engineer.

scenes.say_native: Forma maydonlarini yodlang. Surname — familiya, first name — ism, middle name — otasining ismi. Date of birth — tug‘ilgan sana, nationality — fuqarolik, occupation — kasb, address — manzil, postcode — indeks, phone number — telefon, email, signature — imzo. 'N/A' — tegishli emas. UK formalarda surname birinchi keladi; US formalarda 'last name' deyiladi — ikkalasi bir xil ma’no.
scenes.say: Field vocabulary. Surname — family name; first name; middle name. Date of birth; nationality; occupation; address; postcode; phone number; email; signature. 'N/A' means not applicable. UK forms say surname first; US forms say last name — same meaning.
scenes.say_uz: Maydonlar. Surname — familiya; first name; middle name. Date of birth; nationality; occupation; address; postcode; phone number; email; signature. 'N/A' — tegishli emas. UK — surname birinchi; US — last name; bir xil.

scenes.title: Namuna: ariza namunasi
scenes.say_native: Namuna to‘ldirilgan arizani o‘qing va har maydonga e’tibor bering: ism-familiya bosma harflarda, sana bir xil formatda, bo‘sh joylar N/A bilan yopilgan, oxirida imzo va sana bor. Bunday ariza birinchi marta qabul qilinadi — rad etilmaydi va qayta to‘ldirishingiz talab qilinmaydi.
scenes.say: Surname: KARIMOV. First name: AZAMAT. Middle name: N/A. Date of birth: 12/05/1990. Nationality: Uzbek. Occupation: engineer. Address: 21 Amir Temur Avenue, Tashkent, 100000. Phone: +998 90 123 45 67. Email: a.karimov@mail.com. Signature: Azamat Karimov. Today's date: 03/03/2026.
scenes.say_uz: Surname: KARIMOV. First name: AZAMAT. Middle name: N/A. Date of birth: 12/05/1990. Nationality: Uzbek. Occupation: engineer. Address: 21 Amir Temur Avenue, Tashkent, 100000. Phone: +998 90 123 45 67. Email: a.karimov@mail.com. Signature: Azamat Karimov. Today's date: 03/03/2026.

scenes.title: Maydonlarni inglizchada ayting
scenes.say_native: Arizadagi o‘nta maydonni birma-bir inglizchada ovoz chiqarib nomini ayting: surname, first name, middle name, date of birth, nationality, occupation, address, phone number, email va signature. Har birini to‘g‘ri inglizcha so‘z bilan — yigirma besh soniyada.
scenes.say: Name ten fields aloud in English: surname, first name, middle name, date of birth, nationality, occupation, address, phone number, email, signature. Twenty-five seconds.
scenes.say_uz: O‘nta maydonni inglizchada ayting: surname, first name, middle name, date of birth, nationality, occupation, address, phone number, email, signature. Yigirma besh soniya.

scenes.title: Formalardagi eng keng xatolar
scenes.say_native: Uch xato eng ko‘p uchraydi. Bir: sana formati — '05/06/1990' kimga 5-iyun, kimga 6-may; forma talab qilgan formatda yozing yoki oy nomini yozing — '5 June 1990'. Ikki: imzoni unutish — ariza imzosiz qabul qilinmaydi. Uch: bo‘sh joy qoldirish — ariza rad etiladi; N/A bilan to‘ldiring. Shuningdek: N/A o‘rniga '-' yoki chiziqcha qo‘ymang — asli N/A yoziladi.
scenes.say: Three top errors. One: mixed date formats — write '5 June 1990' or follow the form's DD/MM/YYYY. Two: a missing signature — the form is rejected. Three: blank fields — write 'N/A', don't draw dashes. Forms don't forgive gaps.
scenes.say_uz: Uch xato. Bir: sana formati — '5 June 1990' yozing yoki formadagiga ergashing. Ikki: imzo yo‘q — ariza rad etiladi. Uch: bo‘sh joy — 'N/A', chiziqcha emas. Formalar bo‘sh joyni kechirmaydi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: bankda hisob ochish
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash — bankda hisob ochish kuni. Azamat hujjatlarini — pasport va proof of address — topshiradi, hisob turini tanlaydi, debit karta buyurtma qiladi va pochta muddatini eshitadi. Diqqat bilan tinglang va raqamlarni esda tuting — keyingi sahifada to‘rtta savol bor.
scenes.say: Azamat: Good morning, I'd like to open a current account. Clerk: Of course. Passport and proof of address? Here you are. Clerk: Utility bill or bank statement? A utility bill, from last month. Clerk: Address? 21 Amir Temur Avenue, Tashkent. Clerk: Monthly fee four thousand sums, debit card, online banking. Agreed? Agreed. Clerk: Do you want a savings account as well? Not right now. Clerk: Your account is ready tomorrow; the card arrives by post within a week. Thank you.
scenes.say_uz: Azamat: Xayrli tong, current account ochmoqchiman. Xodim: Albatta. Pasport va proof of address? Mana. Xodim: Kommunal kvitansiya yoki bank ko‘chirmasi? O‘tgan oydagi kommunal kvitansiya. Xodim: Manzilingiz? Amir Temur shoh ko‘chasi yigirma bir, Toshkent. Xodim: Oylik to‘lovi to‘rt ming so‘m, debit karta, onlayn banking. Rozimisiz? Roziman. Xodim: Savings account ham ochasizmi? Hozircha yo‘q. Xodim: Hisob ertaga tayyor; karta bir hafta ichida pochta orqali keladi. Rahmat.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 1
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: Azamat qanday hisob ochdi — current yoki savings? Ikki: proof of address sifatida qaysi hujjatni berdi — kvitansiya yoki ko‘chirma? Uch: oylik to‘lovi qancha va unga nimalar kiradi? To‘rt: karta qachon va qanday yetib keladi? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: which account did Azamat open? Two: which proof of address did he give? Three: what is the monthly fee and what does it include? Four: when and how will the card arrive? Answers in your head.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: qanday hisob ochdi? Ikki: proof of address sifatida nima berdi? Uch: oylik to‘lov qancha va nimalar kiradi? To‘rt: karta qachon va qanday keladi? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 1
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: current account — kundalik hisob. Ikki: o‘tgan oydagi kommunal to‘lov kvitansiyasi. Uch: oylik to‘lovi to‘rt ming so‘m — debit karta va onlayn bank xizmati kiradi. To‘rt: karta bir hafta ichida pochta orqali yetib keladi, hisob esa ertaga tayyor bo‘ladi. Azamat savings accountni hozircha olmadi — har bir hisobning narxi bor.
scenes.say: Answers. One: a current account. Two: last month's utility bill. Three: four thousand sums a month, including the debit card and online banking. Four: the card arrives by post within a week; the account is ready tomorrow. He declined a savings account — accounts cost money.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: current account. Ikki: o‘tgan oydagi kommunal kvitansiya. Uch: to‘rt ming so‘m — debit karta va onlayn bank. To‘rt: karta bir haftada pochta orqali; hisob ertaga. Savings accountdan voz kechdi.

scenes.title: Hujjatlar lug‘ati: pasportdan tashqari
board: utility bill / bank statement — proof of address

examples.t: Can I use my driving licence as ID?
examples.uz: Shaxsni tasdiqlovchi hujjat sifatida haydovchilik guvohnomasidan foydalansam bo‘ladimi?

scenes.say_native: Hujjat turlarini yodlang. Passport — pasport, ID card — shaxsiy guvohnoma, driving licence — haydovchilik guvohnomasi, birth certificate — tug‘ilganlik guvohnomasi, marriage certificate — nikoh guvohnomasi. Manzil uchun: utility bill — kommunal to‘lov; bank statement — bank ko‘chirmasi; council tax bill — soliq kvitansiyasi. Ko‘p idoralar faqat oxirgi uch oydagi hujjatni qabul qiladi — 'dated within the last three months'.
scenes.say: Document types: passport, ID card, driving licence, birth certificate, marriage certificate. For your address: a utility bill, a bank statement, a council tax bill — usually dated within the last three months. Ask: 'Is this document acceptable?' if unsure.
scenes.say_uz: Hujjatlar: passport, ID card, driving licence, birth certificate, marriage certificate. Manzil uchun: utility bill, bank statement, council tax bill — ko‘pincha oxirgi uch oyda berilgan bo‘lishi kerak. Shubha bo‘lsa: 'Is this document acceptable?'

scenes.title: Muddatlar: deadline, due date, extension

examples.t: The deadline is Friday — can I get an extension?
examples.uz: Muddat juma — qo‘shimcha vaqt ola olamanmi?

scenes.say_native: Muddat so‘zlari: deadline — oxirgi topshirish muddati; due date — to‘lov sanasi; extension — qo‘shimcha vaqt; grace period — kichik kechikish uchun imtiyozli muddat; overdue — muddati o‘tgan. So‘rash: 'The deadline is Friday — can I get an extension?' — muddat juma ekan, qo‘shimcha vaqt berasizmi. 'What happens if I miss the deadline?' — muddatni o‘tkazib yuborsam nima bo‘ladi? Kechikish har doim jarima yoki rad javob degani emas — so‘rang, ko‘p hollarda uzaytirib beriladi.
scenes.say: Time words: deadline — the last day to submit; due date — when payment is due; extension — extra time granted; grace period — a short forgiveness window; overdue — past the date. Ask: 'Can I get an extension?' and 'What happens if I miss the deadline?' — asking beats missing.
scenes.say_uz: Vaqt so‘zlari: deadline — topshirish muddati; due date — to‘lov sanasi; extension — qo‘shimcha vaqt; grace period — imtiyozli muddat; overdue — muddati o‘tgan. So‘rang: 'Can I get an extension?' Kechikishdan oldin so‘rash g‘oliblik.

scenes.title: Fe’llar: fill in, submit, renew, attach

examples.t: Please sign the form and submit it by Friday.
examples.uz: Iltimos, formani imzolab, juma kunigacha topshiring.

scenes.say_native: Hujjat fe’llarini yodlang: fill in — to‘ldirish (UK), fill out — US varianti; sign — imzolash; submit — topshirish; enclose — konvertga ilova qilish; attach — biriktirish (email); apply for — ariza berish ('apply for a visa'); renew — yangilash ('renew my passport'); register — ro‘yxatdan o‘tish. Qoida: enclose — qog‘oz konvertda, attach — fayl emailda. Bu farqni aralashtirmang.
scenes.say: Paperwork verbs: fill in UK / fill out US; sign; submit — hand it in; enclose — inside a paper envelope; attach — an email file; apply for — a visa or permit; renew — a passport; register — your address. Remember: enclose is paper, attach is digital.
scenes.say_uz: Hujjat fe’llari: fill in (UK) / fill out (US); sign; submit; enclose — konvert ichida; attach — email fayli; apply for; renew; register. Enclose — qog‘oz, attach — raqamli.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: pasport idorasida
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash — Madina pasport idorasida hujjat topshirmoqda. Suhbatda yangilash to‘lovi, pasportning amal qilish muddati, uchish sanasi va ishlov muddati — ya’ni deadline muhokama qilinadi. Diqqat bilan tinglang va sanalarni esda tuting — keyingi sahifada savollar beriladi.
scenes.say: Madina: Hello, I'd like to renew my passport. Officer: Your current passport? Here it is. Officer: It expires in two months — good timing. Your passport photos? Here. Officer: The fee is two hundred thousand sums. Any proof of address? A utility bill from this month. Officer: Perfect. And the deadline — you need it by your flight on the 28th? My flight is on the 25th. Officer: Standard processing is ten working days — cutting it close. You can pay for express: five days, double fee. Madina: Express, please.
scenes.say_uz: Madina: Salom, pasportimni yangilamoqchiman. Xodim: Joriy pasportingiz? Mana. Xodim: Ikki oydan keyin tugaydi — yaxshi vaqt. Pasport suratlari? Mana. Xodim: To‘lovi ikki yuz ming so‘m. Proof of address bormi? Shu oydagi kommunal kvitansiya. Xodim: Ajoyib. Va muddat — yigirma sakkizinchi reysingiz uchun kerakmi? Reysim yigirma beshinchida. Xodim: Oddiy ishlov — o‘n ish kuni — kam vaqt. Expressga to‘lov qila olasiz: besh kun, ikki baravar to‘lov. Madina: Express, iltimos.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 2
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: Madinaning joriy pasporti qachon tugaydi — necha oyda? Ikki: pasport yangilash to‘lovi qancha so‘m? Uch: Madinaning reysi qachon va oddiy ishlov uchun qancha vaqt yetmaydi? To‘rt: express xizmat necha kun va nega aynan shu variantni tanladi? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: when does Madina's passport expire? Two: what is the renewal fee? Three: when is her flight — and how much time does she have? Four: why did she choose express — how many days is standard processing? Answers in your head.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: qachon tugaydi? Ikki: to‘lov qancha? Uch: reysi qachon, qancha vaqt bor? To‘rt: nega express — oddiy ishlov necha kun? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 2
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: pasport ikki oydan keyin tugaydi. Ikki: yangilash to‘lovi ikki yuz ming so‘m. Uch: Madinaning reysi yigirma beshinchi kuni — oddiy ishlov o‘n ish kuni, ya’ni vaqt deyarli yetmaydi. To‘rt: shuning uchun express — besh kun, ikki baravar to‘lov bilan. Tez-tez takrorlanadigan dars: hujjatlarni muddatidan ancha oldin yangilang.
scenes.say: Answers. One: the passport expires in two months. Two: two hundred thousand sums. Three: her flight is on the 25th — standard processing is ten working days, cutting it close. Four: express takes five days at double the fee. The lesson repeats itself: renew documents well before they expire.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: ikki oydan keyin. Ikki: ikki yuz ming. Uch: reys 25-kuni — oddiy ishlov o‘n ish kuni. To‘rt: express — besh kun, ikki baravar to‘lov. Hujjatni oldindan yangilang.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: receipt, queue, signature

examples.t: Could I have a receipt, please?

scenes.say_native: Uchta hiyla so‘z. 'Receipt' — 'rɪ-SEET': oxiridagi 'p' harfi o‘qilmaydi. 'Queue' — 'KYU': beshta harf, bitta tovush. 'Signature' — 'SIG-na-cher': stress birinchi bo‘g‘inda. 'Address' — 'uh-DRES', USda 'AY-dres' ham uchraydi. 'Document' — 'DOK-yu-ment'. Bu so‘zlar bank va idorada har kuni ishlatiladi — ularni o‘qiyotganda xotirjam ovoz chiqarib takrorlang.
scenes.say: Three trick words. 'Receipt' — 'rɪ-SEET'; the p is silent. 'Queue' — 'KYU'; five letters, one sound. 'Signature' — 'SIG-na-cher', stress on the first syllable. 'Address' — 'uh-DRES'. 'Document' — 'DOK-yu-ment'. These words appear daily at the bank — practise them aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Uch hiyla so‘z. 'Receipt' — 'rɪ-SEET', p jim. 'Queue' — 'KYU', beshta harf — bitta tovush. 'Signature' — 'SIG-na-cher'. 'Address' — 'uh-DRES'. 'Document' — 'DOK-yu-ment'. Har kuni ishlatiladigan so‘zlar — baland ovozda mashq qiling.

scenes.title: 6 tipik xato: bank va hujjatlarda
board: 2 'Make a photocopy' — yaxshi, lekin 'photocopy of my passport'
scenes.say_native: Olti xato. Bir: 'fill the form' emas — 'fill in the form' (UK) yoki 'fill out' (US). Ikki: 'make a photocopy' — to‘g‘ri, lekin 'photocopy of my passport' deb to‘liq ayting. Uch va to‘rt: yosh 'I am twenty' yoki 'I'm twenty years old'; 'I have twenty years' — fransuzcha yoki ruscha ta’sir. Besh: 'give to me' emas — 'give me'. Oltinchi: 'do a visa' emas — 'apply for a visa' yoki 'get a visa'.
scenes.say: Six fixes. 'Fill the form' needs its particle: 'fill in the form' UK, 'fill out' US. 'I have twenty years' is wrong — 'I'm twenty (years old)'. 'Give to me' becomes 'give me'. 'Do a visa' becomes 'apply for a visa' or 'get a visa'. And say 'a photocopy of my passport', not just 'photocopy'.
scenes.say_uz: Olti tuzatish. 'Fill the form' — zarracha kerak: 'fill in' (UK), 'fill out' (US). 'I have twenty years' emas — 'I'm twenty'. 'Give to me' — 'give me'. 'Do a visa' — 'apply for a visa'. 'A photocopy of my passport' deb to‘liq ayting.

scenes.title: Xato → To‘g‘ri: yosh va artikllar
board: ✓ 'Fill in the form' / 'Fill out the form'
scenes.say_native: Ikki eng qimmat xato. Birinchi — yosh: inglizchada yosh egasi fe’l 'to be' bilan keladi: 'I am twenty-five'; 'I have twenty-five years' — inglizcha emas, fransuzcha yoki ispancha ta’siri. Ikkinchisi — zarracha: 'fill in' / 'fill out' — prepositionsize ingizsiz 'fill the form' deymiz, bu xato: 'fill in the form' — formani to‘ldirib qo‘ying.
scenes.say: Two costly errors. Age uses 'to be': 'I'm twenty-five (years old)' — never 'I have twenty-five years'. And the particle is mandatory: 'fill in the form' (UK) or 'fill out the form' (US) — 'fill the form' is incomplete.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki qimmat xato. Yosh 'to be' bilan: 'I'm twenty-five' — 'I have twenty-five years' emas. Zarracha majburiy: 'fill in/out the form' — 'fill the form' yetarli emas.

scenes.title: Xatolarni tuzating
scenes.say_native: Uchta xatoni inglizchaga to‘g‘rilang: 'I have thirty years' — 'I'm thirty (years old)'. 'Fill the form' — 'Fill in the form' yoki 'Fill out the form'. 'Do a visa' — 'Apply for a visa' yoki 'get a visa'. Har birini ovoz chiqarib ayting — yigirma besh soniya.
scenes.say: Fix three: 'I have thirty years' — 'I'm thirty (years old).' 'Fill the form' — 'Fill in the form' or 'Fill out the form.' 'Do a visa' — 'Apply for a visa.' Aloud, twenty-five seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Uchtasini tuzating: 'I have thirty years' — 'I'm thirty (years old).' 'Fill the form' — 'Fill in the form' / 'Fill out the form.' 'Do a visa' — 'Apply for a visa.' Yigirma besh soniya.

scenes.title: Bank dialogini o‘ynang
scenes.say_native: Endi to‘liq bank dialogini o‘ynang. Vaziyat: siz yangi current account ochmoqchisiz. Resepsionga boring: salomlashing, 'I'd like to open a current account' deb ayting, pasport va proof of address topshiring, oylik komissiyani so‘rang va debit karta tanlang. O‘ttiz besh soniya.
scenes.say: Act out the full bank conversation. You're opening a current account: greet the clerk, state your purpose, hand over passport and proof of address, ask about the fees, accept the debit card. Thirty-five seconds.
scenes.say_uz: To‘liq bank suhbatini o‘ynang. Current account ochasiz: salom, 'I'd like to open a current account', pasport va proof of address, oylik to‘lov haqida so‘rang, debit karta tanlang. O‘ttiz besh soniya.

scenes.title: Hujjat topshirishning 3 qadami

examples.t: Could you give me a checklist of the documents?

scenes.say_native: Hujjat topshirishda uch savol: bir — 'Could you give me a checklist of the documents?' — nima kerakligini yozma ro‘yxat qilib oling; ikki — 'What is the deadline?' — muddatni aniq bilib oling; uch — 'Where do I submit it?' — qayerga topshirish. Yozma ro‘yxat sizni ikki marta kelishdan qutqaradi; muddatni o‘n kun oldin belgilab oling — so‘nggi kun shoshilish bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say: Three questions before submitting anything: 'Could you give me a checklist of the documents?' — get the list in writing; 'What is the deadline?' — pin down the date; 'Where do I submit it?' — the exact office or email. A written checklist saves two trips.
scenes.say_uz: Topshirishdan oldin uch savol: 'Could you give me a checklist of the documents?' — yozma ro‘yxat oling; 'What is the deadline?' — aniq sana; 'Where do I submit it?' — aniq idora yoki email. Yozma ro‘yxat ikki marta kelishdan qutqaradi.

scenes.title: Bugungi darsning xulosasi
scenes.say_native: Xulosa: current account kundalik, savings account jamg‘arish uchun. Debit — o‘z pulingiz, credit — bank puli. Standing orderni siz o‘rnatasiz, direct debitni — kompaniya. Formalar: bosma harflar, bir xil sana formati, N/A va imzo. Muddatni oldindan so‘rang — extension har doim so‘rov hisoblanadi.
scenes.say: In short: current for daily life, savings for interest. Debit is your money, credit is the bank's. You set a standing order; companies pull a direct debit. Forms: capital letters, one date format, N/A, signature. And always ask about extensions early — asking beats missing.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: current — kundalik, savings — jamg‘arish. Debit — o‘z pulingiz, credit — bankning. Standing order — siz, direct debit — kompaniya. Forma: bosma harflar, bitta sana formati, N/A, imzo. Extensionni oldindan so‘rang.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Uy vazifasi: formani to‘ldiring va maydonlarni tushuntiring
Keyingi dars: Ijara va kommunal xizmatlar
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: namuna bank arizasini to‘ldiring va har bir maydonni inglizchada tushuntiring — surname, first name, date of birth, nationality, occupation, address, signature. Har maydon uchun ovoz chiqarib bitta jumla ayting: 'Surname is my family name' kabi. Keyingi darsda ijarani o‘rganamiz — ijara e’loni, shartnoma, remont va qo‘shnilar qoidalari. Omad tilayman!
scenes.say: Homework: fill in a sample bank application form and explain every field in English — surname, first name, date of birth, nationality, occupation, address, signature — one sentence each, aloud. Next lesson: renting — rental ads, contracts, repairs and neighbours. Good luck!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: namuna bank arizasini to‘ldiring va har maydonni inglizchada tushuntiring — surname, first name, date of birth, nationality, occupation, address, signature — har biriga bir jumla, ovoz chiqarib. Keyingi dars: ijara va kommunal xizmatlar. Omad tilayman!

options: An account for long-term savings with interest
An everyday account linked to your card and salary
quiz.why_uz: Current account — kundalik hisob: ish haqi tushadi, debit kart undan to‘laydi.

quiz.q: Which proof of address is usually accepted?
options: A handwritten note from a friend
A utility bill dated within the last three months
quiz.why_uz: Utility bill yoki bank statement — ko‘pincha oxirgi uch oyda berilgan bo‘lishi talab qilinadi.

options: A company pulling variable amounts from your account
An instruction you set to pay a fixed amount regularly
quiz.why_uz: Standing order — siz o‘rnatgan doimiy to‘lov: bir xil summa, bir xil sana; direct debit — kompaniya yechadi.

quiz.q: How does a debit card differ from a credit card?
options: A debit card spends money you have; a credit card borrows
A debit card is only for online shopping
A credit card needs your salary
quiz.why_uz: Debit — o‘z pulingiz; credit — bank puli, oylik to‘lovni to‘lamasangiz foizi yuqori.

options: Extra cash you deposit at the ATM
A fee for using another bank's ATM
Spending more than you have in the account
quiz.why_uz: Overdraft — hisobdagi qoldiqdan ortiqcha ishlatish; foizi yuqori, ehtiyot bo‘ling.

options: In pencil, with any date format you like
In capital letters with a consistent date format and your signature
With as many abbreviations as possible
quiz.why_uz: Bosma harflar, bitta sana formati, N/A bo‘sh joylarga va albatta imzo — usiz forma qabul qilinmaydi.

quiz.q: What does 'N/A' mean on a form?
quiz.why_uz: N/A — not applicable: tegishli emas; bo‘sh joy o‘rniga shuni yozing.

options: An extra copy of the document
Extra time granted past a deadline
quiz.why_uz: Extension — qo‘shimcha vaqt; muddatidan oldin so‘rang — kechikishdan keyin emas.
Yosh 'to be' bilan aytiladi: 'I'm twenty-five (years old)' — 'I have … years' fransuzcha ta’siri.

quiz.q: Where do you USUALLY go if your passport expires soon and you fly next week?
options: The standard service — ten working days is fine
The express service — five days at double the fee
quiz.why_uz: Muddat yaqin bo‘lsa express xizmatni tanlang — oddiy ishlov o‘n ish kuni, sizga yetmaydi.
